question:
Six persons A, B, C, D, E, and F have off on six different days of the same week from Monday to Saturday (not necessarily in the same order). No two persons have the same day off. Two persons have a holiday between D and F. Two persons have a holiday between A and E. C's off is immediately after A's off. D's off is on Friday. Which of the following statement is correct?

I. A's off day is on Wednesday. 

II. One person has a holiday between A and B.
